This market will resolve according to the league of the next club Cristiano Ronaldo officially joins, on or before September 1, 2027, 11:59 PM ET.

Ronaldo's current contract with Al Nassr is reported to run to the end of the 2026-27 season. If Cristiano Ronaldo does not officially join a new club by September 1, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Saudi Pro League".

An official transfer announcement before this market's close date will immediately resolve this market to the corresponding option.

Transfers or assignments between a club's senior team and its reserve or affiliate teams will not be considered for this market.

If Cristiano Ronaldo retires, or is not under contract with any professional club by September 1, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution sources will be official announcements from Al Nassr and/or the acquiring club. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
